message.content: {"question":"Let us consider the quadratic form defined by f(x,y)=(x,y)A(x/y)=x²−3xy+8y², where A is a 2×2 real symmetric matrix. Which of the following statements is true? (a) If xy≠0, then f(x,y)>0 (b) The curve defined by f(x,y)=−1 has at least a point w (c) The determinant of A is negative. (d) There exists (a,b)∈R² such that f(a,b)<0.","options":{"A":"If xy≠0, then f(x,y)>0","B":"The curve defined by f(x,y)=−1 has at least a point w","C":"The determinant of A is negative.","D":"There exists (a,b)∈R² such that f(a,b)<0."},"correct":null}
